svg.title: Face gem map
svg.text: Gem guide lines (purple dots) and no-go zones (red hatched). Lesson 06.3, project 8.
Must measure 10 cm. If not, print at 100% ("Actual size").
1 Above the brows, along the brow bone, to the temple · 2 Forehead center · 3 Top of the cheekbone
No gems: eyelids, lash line, the skin just under the eyes, lips. Keep gems away from small children.
Biggest gem at the center or the outer end, smaller gems toward the edges.
